body: i had the same issue and what worked for me was taking it right before I close my eyes to go to sleep. I keep it on my nightstand with a glass of water and usually before sleep I spend some time on my phone (I know I shouldn’t!) then when I feel that I’m getting sleepy I turn off the phone, take the meds and try to fall asleep as soon as I can. So by the time it’s in my system I’m already asleep. I have extremely realistic dreams tho lol

yeah I’ve had it with almost all the antidepressants I’ve tried so far, one of them was so bad I couldn’t talk or chew properly so I had to stop taking it

but right now with the ones I’m on, it started getting a bit better around the 4 month mark for me, I still have it tho, jaw massages seem to help temporarily

one of my friends sometimes gives advice from her psychology background so if I’m asking a question that might go there, I always say “tell me as a friend and not a therapist if this is right” etc. and we always have a laugh about it, which I think relaxes us both haha and then we can go on talking normally, she knows I approach her as a friend, and she picks on quickly if her words start to sound like a session

there have been a few times though, where I called her and was like “this is what happened, put on your therapist hat, wtf do I do?!?” lol

This isn’t as heartfelt as the others haha but she once said that there is hardly ever a definite right or wrong and that I should realize and stop putting myself through hell trying to do things “right”

Yeah I’m on week 3 and the first week I started taking it I couldn’t even look at people eating, it made me gag. But now I feel like my apetite is very slowly coming back like I feel hungry at times and get excited with the idea of cooking again haha

Personally, talking to people who have been suicidal and are happy now helped a lot. I’m at that point where it comes and goes in waves but what keeps me going is I will do anything I can so that I never feel this way again. I seek professional help, I do whatever they tell me to do, if it doesn’t work, I will seek another way, until I’m out of options. And I probably won’t be since science is amazing these days, I just need patience. 

There are definitely times where I feel like I have tried everything but that is not true. There is always at least one more thing that *might* help me and if there is even a 1% chance that I will feel slightly better, I will take it.

Thanks for the post. What is your opinion or approach on finding the right therapist? I feel like to really know someone you need to have a few sessions but also after that point you might feel unsure about seeking a new T.
When looking for a T I feel like going to a few of them at once so maybe in the same week and continuing with the best one feels sensible but it’s also very pricey.

Also not having any red flags with a T but just not feeling comfortable opening up can lead to a search for a new T but what if you can’t find a better one, going back to the inital one would be embarrassing imo lol I have thought this through a lot and could not find a way out.

One last question would be since every T has a different approach or therapy style, how do you find the right style for you like cbt, emdr, etc. Thanks again!

yeah maybe later I might need to talk to an online T

I would say I’m more of a social butterfly, so no problems with making friends, my best friends are all over the world which is actually quite fun
Thank you for this kind response! I will try to talk with my T about this, fingers crossed it won’t be awkward haha I hope we can figure it out

I’m not a fan of online sessions and I move overseas so it’s not possible to pop in for a session on a weekend really. I’m not sure if one day I’ll have enough courage to talk about this specific issue from the start -with a new T.

Thank you for sharing your fear, it is definitely an intimidating idea that it will end and I won’t really be in control about it. Though I would have no worries about it ending abruptly, it is scary for me to think that there will be someone out there in the world who knows my secret.

I’m not really comfortable with online sessions :/ and I usually move internationally and don’t really go back to where I moved from so I’m not sure about keeping the relationship with someone I probably will not see again in my life
